description: A Gemini client's countTokens on a Kimi subscription: today's core translates the request to Messages and asks Kimi's count endpoint ({base_url}/v1/messages/count_tokens), answering in Gemini's shape.

exceptions.reason: A count sent to Kimi carries only what a count takes, with the system instruction as Messages' system; today's core sends the Gemini request through its Gemini-to-Claude translator, which turns the system instruction into a user message and adds max_tokens 32000, stream true and a metadata.user_id hashed from the request.
